ground_truth_question: What is the purpose of BCG’s Global Employee Data Privacy Policy?
ground_truth_answer: The policy explains how BCG collects, uses, discloses, and protects employee personal information in a transparent way and in alignment with applicable privacy laws and regulations. It sets out rules for handling employee data across the firm.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG is committed to protecting the privacy and confidentiality of its employees' personal information. This Global Employee Data Privacy Policy (the “Privacy Policy”) outlines how BCG collects, uses, discloses, and protects employee data transparently and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations.

ground_truth_question: What risk does the policy address and how is it managed?
ground_truth_answer: The policy manages the risk of unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse of employee data by defining rules and safeguards that uphold confidentiality, integrity, and security, and by ensuring compliance with relevant data protection laws and regulations.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: This Privacy Policy aims to maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and security of employee data while ensuring compliance with relevant data protection laws and regulations. It outlines rules and safeguards in place to prevent the potential risk of unauthorized access, disclosure, and misuse of data, either due to internal or external factors.

ground_truth_question: Who is covered by the policy and are contractors included?
ground_truth_answer: The policy applies worldwide to all employees, directors, Partners, and officers of BCG and its subsidiaries and affiliates. It does not apply to contractors.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: This Privacy Policy applies worldwide to all employees, directors, Partners, and officers (“employees”) of The Boston Consulting Group Inc. and all its subsidiaries and affiliates worldwide (“BCG”). It does not apply to contractors.

ground_truth_question: Are an employee’s beneficiaries and emergency contacts covered, and what must employees do regarding them?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. The policy also applies to individuals covered by an employee’s benefits, such as those on the employee’s health plan, beneficiaries of retirement accounts, and the employee’s emergency contacts. Employees are responsible for informing those individuals about the policy and ensuring they have the right to provide their personal data to BCG.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: It also applies to the beneficiaries of employee’s employment benefits, such as the individuals who are on employee’s health plan and the beneficiaries of employee’s retirement accounts, as well as employee’s emergency contacts. It is the employee’s responsibility to inform any such individuals about this Privacy Policy and ensure that they have the right to provide their Personal Data to BCG.

ground_truth_question: What core personnel and benefits records does BCG maintain for employees?
ground_truth_answer: BCG maintains personnel and benefits records for all employees as part of its role as data controller and processes this data under legitimate interests given the employer–employee relationship.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG maintains and collects personnel and benefits records for all employees… BCG is data controller for the purposes of collecting and storing our employees’ Personal Data. Given the employer/employee relationship, we rely upon legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing employee Personal Data.

ground_truth_answer: Employee records can include identifiers and work systems data (e.g., employee identification number, time & billing system identifiers, payroll identifier and country), travel and work location information, office contact details, employment dates and status, base hours, job title and function, cohort, salary and other payments, tax data, benefits and insurance enrollment status, responsibility and cost centre information, and employment documents such as applications, employment agreements where applicable, performance reviews, letters of commendation or disciplinary warnings, and other employment-related documents.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: The information in these records includes: • employee identification number; • time & billing system identifiers; • payroll identifier and country; • travel information; • work locations; • office contact information; • dates of employment; • employment status; • base hours; • job title; • job function/career step and cohort; • salary; • other payments and tax data; • benefits and insurance enrolment status; • responsibility centre; • cost centre allocations; • employment application; • employment agreement (if applicable); • performance reviews, • letters of commendation and disciplinary warnings; • and other documents related to your employment.

ground_truth_question: Beyond HR records, what other personal data does BCG maintain about employees?
ground_truth_answer: BCG may hold additional personal data such as names and titles, device IP addresses, work and home contact details, date of birth, bank account and pension/benefits information, citizenship and nationality, passport or identification details, visa issuance data, educational background, background check results, demographic details like gender and marital status, photographs, national identification numbers, next‑of‑kin and emergency contacts, and other information collected in the course of employment.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG also maintains other Personal Data concerning each employee, such as: • the person’s names and titles; • device IP addresses, • work address and telephone number; • home address and telephone number; • date of birth; • bank account details; • pension and benefits information; • citizenship and nationality; • passport or identification document details; • visa issuance data; • educational background; • criminal or credit check data as a result of background checks; • gender; • marital status; • photograph; • social insurance or national identification numbers; • next of kin and emergency contact information; and • other information collected in the course of employment.

ground_truth_answer: BCG stores personal data in systems and applications located in Europe and the United States. Access is limited to authorized persons or vendors who are bound by privacy requirements.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG maintains and stores Personal Data in systems and applications located in Europe and the United States, and the Personal Data is only accessible by authorized persons or vendors who are bound by privacy requirements.

ground_truth_question: Where can employee personal data be processed and what governs transfers within BCG?
ground_truth_answer: Personal data may be processed in various locations where BCG conducts business, including the United States and other countries. Transfers within BCG entities are governed by intra‑company agreements, local data export restrictions, and applicable local privacy laws.

Data transfers within BCG entities are governed by BCG’s intra company agreements, local data export restrictions and/or local data privacy laws.

ground_truth_question: For what purposes does BCG use employee personal data?
ground_truth_answer: BCG uses employee personal data to run its employment and business processes. Purposes include payroll processing; benefit and compensation programs; preparing proposals to prospective clients; assessing performance or suitability, including for internal moves; performing the employment contract; analyzing office access and operations; identifying work locations; travel and security administration; time recording and reporting; internal directories such as BCG Navigator and the Alumni Directory; workforce composition analysis; assignment and advancement decisions; business administration and internal communications; productivity measurement; policy compliance; insurance administration; other BCG programs and systems; and compliance with legal obligations.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Personal Data is used to manage following purposes: • processing payroll; • benefit and compensation programs; • preparing proposals to prospective clients; • assessing performance or suitability for employment (including internal moves); • performance of the employment contract; • facilitating analysis of office access and operations; • identifying work locations; • travel and security administration; • time recording and reporting; • BCG Navigator or other internal directories such as BCG’s Alumni Directory; • analysing the composition of BCG’s workforce; • making assignment and advancement decisions; • administering BCG’s business and facilitating internal communications; • measuring productivity; • assuring compliance with BCG’s policies; • administering insurance; • administering other BCG programs and systems; and • complying with legal obligations.

Any sensitive data collected is in accordance with BCG’s global policies and local laws, where applicable.

ground_truth_question: How is sensitive personal data used?

ground_truth_question: When and how does BCG disclose personal data outside the firm?
ground_truth_answer: BCG discloses personal data only as necessary for valid business purposes or where required by law, and anonymizes information whenever possible before disclosure.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG appreciates the confidential nature of Personal Data and discloses it only as necessary for BCG’s valid business purposes or as required by law, although whenever possible to do so, information will be anonymized prior to its production.

ground_truth_question: For what legitimate purposes might BCG disclose personal data to third parties?
ground_truth_answer: Disclosures may support bidding on, performing, or reporting on client work; working with reference agencies; facilitating work by contractors or service providers such as benefits, payroll, insurance, travel, risk and security, legal, accounting, or data processing providers; tax or regulatory compliance; asserting or defending BCG’s rights; preventing harm; supporting law enforcement investigations; complying with court or administrative orders; and transactions such as mergers, acquisitions, or insolvency proceedings, or as otherwise required by law.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG’s legitimate purposes include: • bidding on, performing, and reporting on projects for clients or prospective clients; • working with reference agencies who undertake checks on BCG’s behalf; • facilitating work by contractors or service providers (e.g., benefits and payroll administrators, insurance brokers, travel agents and travel suppliers; risk and security services firms; attorneys, accountants, and data processing service providers) on behalf of or for the benefit of BCG or its employees; • complying with tax reporting or other regulatory requirements; • asserting or defending the rights of BCG; • preventing harm to property or persons; • assisting in a law enforcement investigation; • complying with a court or administrative order; • in connection with a corporate transaction involving BCG such as a merger, acquisition, or insolvency proceeding; • or as otherwise required by law.

ground_truth_question: What basic employment details may BCG confirm in response to appropriate inquiries?
ground_truth_answer: BCG may, at its discretion, disclose or confirm an employee’s name, job title, and dates of employment when appropriate and when anonymization is not feasible.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: In response to appropriate inquires, and where such information cannot be otherwise provided in an anonymized form, BCG may, in its discretion, disclose or confirm an employee’s name, job title, and dates of employment.

ground_truth_question: Does BCG transfer personal information across borders and where might third parties be located?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. As a global organization BCG may transfer personal information across geographic borders to BCG entities, service providers, or business partners in other countries, including locations outside the EEA, Switzerland, and the UK.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Since BCG is a global organization, it may need to transfer personal information across geographical borders to BCG entities, service providers or business partners in other countries working on BCG’s behalf in accordance with applicable privacy laws. BCG’s affiliates and third parties may be based in different countries around the world, including outside of the EEA, Switzerland, and the UK.

ground_truth_question: What privacy protections must third parties provide when accessing employee data?
ground_truth_answer: Third parties that obtain access to employee personal data to perform services for or on behalf of BCG must assure in writing that they will provide at least the level of privacy protection that BCG provides.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Accordingly, third parties obtaining access to Personal Data about employees for purposes of performing services for or on behalf of BCG, are required to assure BCG in writing that they will provide at least the level of privacy protection as BCG provides.

ground_truth_question: Does BCG disclose employee personal data for marketing purposes?
ground_truth_answer: No. BCG does not disclose employee personal data for purposes not described in the policy or to unaffiliated third parties for commercial or marketing purposes.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG does not disclose Personal Data about employees for purposes not described herein or to unaffiliated third parties for commercial or marketing purposes.

ground_truth_question: How can an employee access and review their personnel file, and where must the review occur?
ground_truth_answer: Subject to local law, employees can access and review their personnel file by contacting local HR staff or the Office Administrator, and reviews must take place in the HR office.

ground_truth_question: How are errors corrected and what ongoing obligations do employees have regarding their data?

ground_truth_question: Does BCG sell or share employee personal data under the CPRA?

BCG has not engaged in such activities in the 12 months preceding the date this Privacy Policy was last updated. Without limiting the foregoing, BCG does not “sell” or “share” the Personal Data, including the sensitive Personal Data, of minors under 16 years of age.

ground_truth_question: For what purposes may BCG use or disclose Sensitive Personal Data under the CPRA?
ground_truth_answer: BCG uses or discloses Sensitive Personal Data to perform services for its business; detect security incidents; resist malicious, deceptive, fraudulent or illegal actions; ensure physical safety; support short‑term transient use (including certain non‑personalized advertising); maintain or service accounts, provide requested services and ensure security; and verify and maintain the quality, safety, and improvement of services or products.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG does not use or disclose sensitive Personal Data outside of the following purposes: • performing services for its business, • detecting security incidents, • resisting malicious, deceptive, fraudulent, or illegal actions, • ensuring physical safety, • for short-term transient use, including certain non-personalized advertising, • maintaining or servicing accounts, providing customer service, or providing similar services as requested by employees, and ensuring the security, • verifying and maintaining the quality or safety of a service or product or improving, upgrading, or enhancing a service or product.

ground_truth_question: What business functions specifically rely on Sensitive Personal Data under the CPRA?

exact_excerpt_from_policy: This includes, without limitation, establishing and maintaining: • the employment relationship with BCG; • ensuring the diversity of BCG’s workforce; • complying with legal obligations; • managing payroll and corporate credit card use; • administering and providing benefits; and • securing the access to, and use of, our facilities, equipment, systems, networks, applications, and infrastructure.

ground_truth_question: Can employees limit BCG’s use or disclosure of sensitive personal data under the CPRA?

exact_excerpt_from_policy: Accordingly, BCG does not offer the right to limit the use or disclosure of the employees’ sensitive Personal Data under the CPRA.

ground_truth_question: How long does BCG retain personal data and what criteria determine the retention period?

exact_excerpt_from_policy: BCG retains Personal Data including, without limitation, sensitive Personal Data for as long as needed or permitted in light of the purpose(s) for which it was collected. The criteria used to determine our retention periods include: • The duration of employment; • The length of time BCG has an ongoing relationship with its employees or their dependents/beneficiaries and the length of time thereafter during which BCG may have a legitimate need to reference employees Personal Data to address issues that may arise; • Whether there is a legal obligation to which BCG is subject (for example, certain laws may require us to keep your employment records for a certain period of time); and • Whether retention is advisable in light of its legal position (such as in regard to applicable statutes of limitations, litigation or regulatory investigations).
